description: When the current deterministic, staged solution shows no improvement, guide the LLM to propose a joint, global optimisation that directly maximises the overall objective while handling constraints via penalties.

guidance.idea: Detect plateaus in score improvement; replace the existing pipeline (e.g., generate‑then‑solve) with a single optimisation loop that optimises all free parameters together.
guidance.transfer_rule: Apply to any task where the code separates structure generation from a downstream optimisation (e.g., layout → LP, model → training).
actions: Monitor recent generations; if improvement < ε for k iterations, flag a plateau.
Prompt the LLM: *“Replace the two‑stage approach with a single global optimiser that treats all parameters as free variables. Use a penalty‑based fitness to enforce constraints.”*
Suggest seeding the new optimiser with the best‑so‑far solution to preserve useful knowledge.
Require the LLM to emit code that calls a gradient‑free optimiser (CMA‑ES, DE, etc.) and computes a penalised objective.
cautions: Ensure the new optimiser respects any hard runtime limits.
Keep the penalty formulation well‑scaled to avoid numerical instability.
Validate that the generated code still compiles and runs before evaluation.
